params.caption: 🎮 GTA 5 is helping researchers make real roads safer Universities are turning Los Santos into a cheap road-safety lab instead of pricey driving simulators. Osnabrück researchers tested vibrating cyclist-warning devices in a modded GTA 5, Eindhoven tracked how riders spot hazards, and KAIST trained AI on in-game crashes. An Eastern Michigan study says its AI cut potential deaths by about 24% in simulations. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 23:38 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto 👥 @RockstarGames 🚗 React if this is the coolest use of GTA yet · 💬 What game should science use next? #GTA5 #RockstarGames #RoadSafety #GamingNews
